Query.Sql: select nhs_number, EVENT_END_DT_TM, EVENT, RESULT_VALUE, case when trim(EVENT) in ('Weight', 'Weight Measured') and (RESULT_UNITS is null or lower(trim(RESULT_UNITS)) in ('', '<no data>')) then 'kg' else RESULT_UNITS end as RESULT_UNITS, NORMAL_LOW, NORMAL_HIGH from ##duckdb_source## order by all

Explanation.Description: Original units; null, blank or <no data> units default to kg for Weight and Weight Measured events only.
